subject: English
question_text: Fill in the blanks with suitable words. Use one word
stimulus: only in each blank. 1×5=5 Barak Obama was born to a (a)  mother and a black father in America. As his parents were (b)  he was raised by his grandparents. He studied at the (c)  school in Hawaii. Then he studied (d)  at Harvard Law School. He was (e)  the president of the USA twice.
guide_solution: Filling in gaps without clues (a) white; (b) separated; (c) Punabu; (d) Law; (e) elected.
